name: PathBench
description: PathBench is a comprehensive benchmark for pathology foundation models, evaluating their performance across diagnosis and prognosis tasks in computational histopathology. It includes multi-center datasets from 10 hospitals, covering over 64 tasks and 15,888 whole-slide images, with strict data leakage prevention and an automated leaderboard for continuous assessment.
reputation: A new pathology benchmark that is still emerging, but it is positioned as a comprehensive multi-center evaluation suite for foundation models in computational histopathology.
notes: Includes 15,888 WSIs from 8,549 patients across 10 hospitals; strict exclusion of pretraining data to avoid leakage; covers diagnosis to prognosis tasks.
